_rules: Owner's method, 15 Nov 2026 (docs/DECISIONS.md). major: a new major version (the first number), and the only kind of release that may add or remove a module, change a function with financial effect, or change the database framework (RMO 9-2021 V.8); the client chooses to move and files an update of registration with its RDO before using it. minor: bug fixes and small field changes (for example manual entry to a searchable dropdown) within the same major version; listed in one combined written notice per client per quarter (RMO 9-2021 V.9). Enterprise clients follow the same rules.
_start: Empty until the owner declares the product done; the first release for registration will be 1.0.0 (class major), and ph_cas.__version__ moves to it in the same change.
